name: Ethics
overview: Scripture teaches that ethics are rooted in integrity, fairness, and love. God delights in honest dealings, as shown by the condemnation of false balances and the call for just weights in business (Proverbs 11:1). Personal conduct should reflect uprightness and integrity, trusting in God’s guidance (Psalms 25:21). At the heart of ethical behavior is the command to love others as Christ loved us, fulfilling the law through love rather than debt (John 13:34; Romans 13:8). This principle extends to all relationships and actions, including business and work ethics, emphasizing treating others as we desire to be treated (Matthew 7:12).
